Two changes

A different game emerges.

Familiar pieces acquire unfamiliar incentives. Leading is powerful, following is costly, and a conventional check can hand the opponent new freedom.

01 / 03

No side walls

Bishops, rooks, queens, kings, knights, pawns, and en passant all respect the cylindrical seam.

02 / 03

Forced pursuit

The previous origin becomes the follow field. If at least one legal follower exists, every other move is forbidden.

03 / 03

Purpose-built search

Kugelfisch is a handcrafted, single-worker C++ engine measured by deterministic benchmarks and paired self-play.

The challenge

Play, then inspect the line.

Depth 10 is the standard game. The engine uses one CPU worker and ponders while you choose your reply.
